where: The Drownlight relit (after the dawn) — its lantern room and its foot, the beam out over the coast and the buoys waking
mood: The Keeper's Hymn turned major — the lamp turning again: flute and bells over swelling strings and harp, warm and grateful.
_note: Lane N2, Drownlight family RELIGHT: the anchor's hymn in D MAJOR, whole and warm (the minor -> major lamp beat). On the 76 grid; brightness comes from harmony and orchestration. Never name the tune or mention the reference in a brief.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
airy sampled flute and glass bells together carrying the hymn
harp arpeggios turning like a lighthouse lens
soft brushed snare and a gentle bass drum on each downbeat
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat

sections.text: {the tower's hymn in D major on flute and glass bells, up a fourth, a lift to the bright major third, then home, over harp arpeggios}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast in G major: the strings carry the tune while the harp turns and turns, the light sweeping out over the sea}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the major hymn on flute and bells, the last bar lifting straight back into the top of the theme}
